fact: Lei n.º 03/2025, the central bank's organic law (published 5 June 2025, which is the date used), makes the Banco Central responsible for regulating and overseeing payment systems and lets its board adopt binding regulations and decide licences for payment systems and financial institutions; it replaces Lei n.º 08/92 and refers detailed payment rules to special legislation.

fact: Lei n.º 17/2018, published in the Diário da República on 7 September 2018, sets the legal regime for regulating, overseeing and managing the National Payment System, covering payment services including electronic money issuance, and applies to any payment service or system operating wholly or partly in the country.

Lei n.º 17/2018 (2018) lets the central bank BCSTP authorise and licence payment service providers, defined as any entity providing payment services including e-money issuance, separately from banks, which need no new authorisation for payment services but do need one to operate systems.
